baochungitdefold-wrap

baochungit/defold-wrap/wrap.node

A chainable wrapper around a GUI node. new wraps a node or looks one up by id, and each method calls the gui.* function of the same name with the wrapped node first: setters return the wrapper, so calls chain, and getters return what the engine does.

  • GitHub: baochungit/defold-wrap — pinned to 1.1.0
    1. Pick a release from baochungit/defold-wrap releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

Functions

Animates one property with gui.animate.

Parameters

  • property: AnimatedProperty — The property to animate.
  • to: AnimatedValue — The value to animate it to.
  • easing: gui.Easing | Vector — An easing constant, or a vector of easing samples.
  • duration: number — The duration in seconds.
  • delay?: number — The delay in seconds before the animation starts. Defaults to 0.
  • complete_function?: (self: unknown, node: Opaque<'node'>) => void — Called once the animation completes.
  • playback?: gui.Playback — The playback mode. Defaults to gui.PLAYBACK_ONCE_FORWARD.

Returns

Node.animate(property: readonly AnimatedProperty[], to: readonly AnimatedValue[], easing: gui.Easing | Vector, duration: number, delay?: number, complete_function?: (self: unknown, node: Opaque<'node'>) => void, playback?: gui.Playback): Node

Animates several properties with gui.animate, each to the value at the same index of to, all with the same easing, duration, delay and playback.

Parameters

  • property: readonly AnimatedProperty[] — The properties to animate.
  • to: readonly AnimatedValue[] — The value to animate each property to, by index.
  • easing: gui.Easing | Vector — An easing constant, or a vector of easing samples.
  • duration: number — The duration in seconds.
  • delay?: number — The delay in seconds before the animations start. Defaults to 0.
  • complete_function?: (self: unknown, node: Opaque<'node'>) => void — Called once the first property's animation completes.
  • playback?: gui.Playback — The playback mode. Defaults to gui.PLAYBACK_ONCE_FORWARD.

Returns

  • Node
